khmer: កក់ទុកមុន
breakdown: 预(beforehand)+定(fix, settle) — settling it in advance

examples.cn: 请帮我预定下个月去中国的机票。
examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ yùdìng xià ge yuè qù Zhōngguó de jīpiào.
examples.en: Please help me book next month's air ticket to China.

examples.py: Wǒ zài cāntīng yùdìng le zuòwèi.
examples.en: I reserved a seat at the restaurant.

examples.cn: 旅馆的房间要提前预定。
examples.py: Lǚguǎn de fángjiān yào tíqián yùdìng.
examples.en: The hotel room must be booked in advance.

examples.py: Nǐ yùdìng hǎo le ma?
examples.en: Have you made the reservation?

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng yùdìng liǎng zhāng piào.
examples.en: I'd like to book two tickets.

khmer: សំបុត្រយន្តហោះ
breakdown: 机(machine, plane)+票(ticket) — a plane ticket

examples.cn: 坐飞机之前我们都需要购买机票。
examples.py: Zuò fēijī zhīqián wǒmen dōu xūyào gòumǎi jīpiào.
examples.en: Before flying we all need to buy an air ticket.

examples.py: Jīpiào hěn guì.
examples.en: The air ticket is expensive.

examples.py: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi jīpiào.
examples.en: I buy air tickets online.

examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ chá yíxià jīpiào.
examples.en: Please help me check the air ticket.

examples.py: Wǒ de jīpiào diū le.
examples.en: I lost my air ticket.

khmer: សណ្ឋាគារ
breakdown: 旅(travel)+馆(building, house) — a house for travelers

examples.cn: 在贡布有很多大大小小的旅馆。
examples.py: Zài Gòngbù yǒu hěn duō dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de lǚguǎn.
examples.en: In Kampot there are many hotels big and small.

examples.py: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This hotel is very clean.

examples.py: Wǒmen zhù zài lǚguǎn lǐ.
examples.en: We are staying in a hotel.

examples.cn: 这个旅馆的价格很合适。
examples.py: Zhège lǚguǎn de jiàgé hěn héshì.
examples.en: This hotel's price is reasonable.

examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ yùdìng yì jiā lǚguǎn.
examples.en: Please help me book a hotel.

khmer: រៀបចំ / ត្រៀម
breakdown: 准(accurate)+备(ready, provide) — getting everything ready in order

examples.py: Xiànzài zhǔnbèi chūfā le.
examples.en: Now we're getting ready to depart.

examples.py: Wǒmen bìxū zhǔnbèi hǎo.
examples.en: We must be well prepared.

examples.py: Qǐng zhǔnbèi hǎo cáiliào.
examples.en: Please prepare the materials.

examples.py: Kǎoshì yǐqián yào hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: Prepare well before the exam.

examples.py: Wǒ zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: I prepared for a long time.

khmer: ឥវ៉ាន់
breakdown: 行(travel)+李(bags) — the bags you travel with

examples.cn: 每次出差我带的行李都不多。
examples.py: Měi cì chūchāi wǒ dài de xíngli dōu bù duō.
examples.en: Every business trip I don't bring much luggage.

examples.py: Wǒ de xíngli hěn zhòng.
examples.en: My luggage is very heavy.

examples.py: Qǐng jiǎnchá nǐ de xíngli.
examples.en: Please check your luggage.

examples.py: Chūfā qián shōushi hǎo xíngli.
examples.en: Pack your luggage before leaving.

examples.py: Xíngli zài nǎr qǔ?
examples.en: Where do I collect my luggage?

khmer: វ៉ាលីធ្វើដំណើរ
breakdown: 旅行(travel)+箱(box) — a box for traveling

examples.cn: 坐飞机之前我们需要托运旅行箱。
examples.py: Zuò fēijī zhīqián wǒmen xūyào tuōyùn lǚxíngxiāng.
examples.en: Before flying we need to check in the suitcase.

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yí ge xīn lǚxíngxiāng.
examples.en: I bought a new travel suitcase.

examples.py: Zhège lǚxíngxiāng tài zhòng le.
examples.en: This suitcase is too heavy.

examples.py: Lǚxíngxiāng zài ménkǒu.
examples.en: The suitcase is at the door.

examples.py: Bāng wǒ bān yíxià lǚxíngxiāng.
examples.en: Help me move the suitcase.

khmer: ប្ដូរ / ដូរ
breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+奂 — a hand swapping one thing for another

examples.cn: 出国之前我们都会换一些外币。
examples.py: Chū guó zhīqián wǒmen dōu huì huàn yìxiē wàibì.
examples.en: Before going abroad we all exchange some foreign currency.

examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ huàn língqián.
examples.en: Please help me change small money.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yí ge zuòwèi.
examples.en: I'd like to change seats.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài xiǎo, wǒ yào huàn.
examples.en: This clothing is too small, I want to exchange it.

examples.py: Zài zhèlǐ huàn dēngjīpái.
examples.en: Get your boarding pass here.

khmer: រូបិយប័ណ្ណបរទេស
breakdown: 外(outside, foreign)+币(currency) — money from outside the country

examples.cn: 如果你需要外币，可以去银行换。
examples.py: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào wàibì, kěyǐ qù yínháng huàn.
examples.en: If you need foreign currency, you can exchange it at the bank.

examples.py: Wǒ méiyǒu wàibì.
examples.en: I don't have foreign currency.

examples.cn: 外币的价格每天都在变。
examples.py: Wàibì de jiàgé měitiān dōu zài biàn.
examples.en: Foreign currency rates change every day.

examples.py: Yínháng kěyǐ huàn wàibì.
examples.en: The bank can exchange foreign currency.

examples.py: Chū guó yào dài yìxiē wàibì.
examples.en: Bring some foreign currency when going abroad.

khmer: ពិនិត្យ / ស្វែងរក
breakdown: 木(wood radical)+且 — originally about examining wood; now to check or look up

examples.cn: 小姐，请帮我查一下明天飞北京的机票。
examples.py: Xiǎojiě, qǐng bāng wǒ chá yíxià míngtiān fēi Běijīng de jīpiào.
examples.en: Miss, please check tomorrow's ticket flying to Beijing for me.

examples.py: Wǒ yòng cídiǎn chá shēngcí.
examples.en: I use a dictionary to look up new words.

examples.py: Qǐng chá yíxià nǐ de dá'àn.
examples.en: Please check your answer.

examples.py: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng chá zīliào.
examples.en: I look up information online.

examples.py: Jǐngchá zài chá zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: The police are investigating this.

khmer: ឯកសារ / ព័ត៌មាន
breakdown: 资(resource)+料(material) — resource material

examples.cn: 报名的时候都要先填写资料。
examples.py: Bàomíng de shíhou dōu yào xiān tiánxiě zīliào.
examples.en: When registering you must first fill in your information.

examples.py: Qǐng zhǔnbèi hǎo zīliào.
examples.en: Please prepare the documents.

examples.py: Wǒ zài shōují zīliào.
examples.en: I'm collecting information.

examples.py: Zhèxiē zīliào hěn yǒuyòng.
examples.en: This information is very useful.

examples.py: Shēnqǐng yào jiāo hěn duō zīliào.
examples.en: The application requires many documents.

english: to do; to handle; to apply for
khmer: រៀបចំ / ធ្វើ
breakdown: Whole shape — to handle or take care of a task

examples.cn: 外国人在柬埔寨都需要办签证。
examples.py: Wàiguó rén zài Jiǎnpǔzhài dōu xūyào bàn qiānzhèng.
examples.en: Foreigners in Cambodia all need to apply for a visa.

examples.py: Wǒ yào qù yínháng bàn kǎ.
examples.en: I'm going to the bank to get a card.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì hěn nán bàn.
examples.en: This matter is hard to handle.

examples.py: Bàn hùzhào yào duō cháng shíjiān?
examples.en: How long does it take to get a passport?

examples.py: Zhège wǒ lái bàn.
examples.en: I'll take care of this.

khmer: ទិដ្ឋាការ
breakdown: 签(sign)+证(certificate) — a signed certificate to enter a country

examples.cn: 外国人在柬埔寨都需要办签证。
examples.py: Wàiguó rén zài Jiǎnpǔzhài dōu xūyào bàn qiānzhèng.
examples.en: Foreigners in Cambodia all need to apply for a visa.

examples.py: Wǒ de qiānzhèng xià ge yuè dàoqī.
examples.en: My visa expires next month.

examples.py: Qiānzhèng zài dàshǐguǎn bàn.
examples.en: Visas are handled at the embassy.

examples.py: Méiyǒu qiānzhèng bù néng chū guó.
examples.en: Without a visa you can't go abroad.

examples.py: Bàn qiānzhèng yào hěn duō zīliào.
examples.en: Getting a visa requires many documents.

khmer: លិខិតឆ្លងដែន
breakdown: 护(protect)+照(certificate) — a document that protects you abroad

examples.cn: 没有护照我们不可以出国。
examples.py: Méiyǒu hùzhào wǒmen bù kěyǐ chū guó.
examples.en: Without a passport we can't go abroad.

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn nǐ de hùzhào.
examples.en: Please show me your passport.

examples.py: Wǒ de hùzhào diū le.
examples.en: I lost my passport.

examples.py: Hùzhào zài wǒ de bāo lǐ.
examples.en: The passport is in my bag.

examples.py: Chū guó yào dài hùzhào hé qiānzhèng.
examples.en: To go abroad bring your passport and visa.

khmer: ធានារ៉ាប់រង
breakdown: 保(protect)+险(risk, danger) — protection against risk

examples.cn: 你有没有给你的车子买保险？
examples.py: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu gěi nǐ de chēzi mǎi bǎoxiǎn?
examples.en: Have you bought insurance for your car?

examples.cn: 旅行前买保险比较安全。
examples.py: Lǚxíng qián mǎi bǎoxiǎn bǐjiào ānquán.
examples.en: Buying insurance before traveling is safer.

examples.py: Zhège bǎoxiǎn hěn piányi.
examples.en: This insurance is cheap.

examples.py: Jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: Health insurance is important.

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le lǚxíng bǎoxiǎn.
examples.en: I bought travel insurance.

khmer: បណ្ណបើកបរ
breakdown: 驾(drive)+照(certificate, license) — a license to drive

examples.py: Nǐ yǒu jiàzhào ma?
examples.en: Do you have a driver's license?

examples.py: Méiyǒu jiàzhào bù néng kāichē.
examples.en: You can't drive without a license.

examples.py: Wǒ qùnián kǎo le jiàzhào.
examples.en: I got my driver's license last year.

examples.py: Qǐng chūshì nǐ de jiàzhào.
examples.en: Please show your driver's license.

examples.py: Jiàzhào diū le yào chóngxīn bàn.
examples.en: If you lose your license you must reapply.

breakdown: 登(record, ascend)+记(record) — writing your name into a record

examples.cn: 你好，请在这里登记一下你的名字。
examples.py: Nǐ hǎo, qǐng zài zhèlǐ dēngjì yíxià nǐ de míngzi.
examples.en: Hello, please register your name here.

examples.py: Zhù lǚguǎn yào xiān dēngjì.
examples.en: You must check in first to stay at a hotel.

examples.py: Dēngjì de shíhou yào dài hùzhào.
examples.en: Bring your passport when registering.

examples.py: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ dēngjì xìnxī.
examples.en: Please register your information here.

examples.py: Wǒ yǐjīng dēngjì hǎo le.
examples.en: I've already registered.

khmer: កៅអីលើយន្តហោះ
breakdown: 机(plane)+位(position, seat) — your position on the plane

examples.cn: 先生，请问你的机位是在几号？
examples.py: Xiānsheng, qǐngwèn nǐ de jīwèi shì zài jǐ hào?
examples.en: Sir, may I ask what number your seat is?

examples.py: Wǒ de jīwèi zài chuānghu pángbiān.
examples.en: My seat is next to the window.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yí ge jīwèi.
examples.en: I'd like to change my seat.

examples.py: Jīwèi hào zài dēngjīpái shàng.
examples.en: The seat number is on the boarding pass.

examples.py: Zhège jīwèi yǒu rén ma?
examples.en: Is this seat taken?

khmer: រៀបចំ
breakdown: 安(settle)+排(line up) — settling things into a line

examples.cn: 我需要安排一下最近的行程。
examples.py: Wǒ xūyào ānpái yíxià zuìjìn de xíngchéng.
examples.en: I need to arrange my recent itinerary.

examples.py: Zhège ānpái hěn héshì.
examples.en: This arrangement is suitable.

examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ ānpái zhùsù.
examples.en: Please help me arrange accommodation.

examples.py: Zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme ānpái?
examples.en: What are your plans for the weekend?

examples.py: Jīnglǐ ānpái wǒ qù chūchāi.
examples.en: The manager arranged for me to go on a business trip.

khmer: កម្មវិធីធ្វើដំណើរ
breakdown: 行(travel)+程(journey, stage) — the stages of a journey

examples.cn: 我需要安排一下最近的行程。
examples.py: Wǒ xūyào ānpái yíxià zuìjìn de xíngchéng.
examples.en: I need to arrange my recent itinerary.

examples.py: Wǒmen de xíngchéng gǎibiàn le.
examples.en: Our itinerary changed.

examples.py: Zhè cì de xíngchéng hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: This trip's schedule is very tight.

examples.cn: 我去中国的行程可能要延后。
examples.py: Wǒ qù Zhōngguó de xíngchéng kěnéng yào yánhòu.
examples.en: My trip to China may be postponed.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ xíngchéng fā gěi wǒ.
examples.en: Please send me the itinerary.

khmer: កន្លែងស្នាក់នៅ
breakdown: 住(live, stay)+宿(lodge, 宀roof radical) — staying overnight under a roof

examples.cn: 请帮我安排好住宿的问题。
examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ ānpái hǎo zhùsù de wèntí.
examples.en: Please arrange the accommodation for me.

examples.py: Xuéxiào tígōng zhùsù.
examples.en: The school provides accommodation.

examples.py: Zhùsù de fèiyòng shì duōshao?
examples.en: How much is the accommodation cost?

examples.cn: 旅行的住宿已经订好了。
examples.py: Lǚxíng de zhùsù yǐjīng dìng hǎo le.
examples.en: The travel accommodation is already booked.

examples.py: Zhèlǐ de zhùsù hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: The accommodation here is convenient.

khmer: ទាន់ពេលវេលា
breakdown: 准(exact)+时(time) — exactly on time

examples.py: Fēijī míng wǎn zhǔnshí dàodá.
examples.en: The plane arrives on time tomorrow night.

examples.py: Qǐng zhǔnshí lái.
examples.en: Please come on time.

examples.py: Tā měi cì dōu hěn zhǔnshí.
examples.en: He is punctual every time.

examples.py: Huìyì zhǔnshí kāishǐ.
examples.en: The meeting starts on time.

examples.py: Zhǔnshí shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.en: Punctuality is a form of politeness.

khmer: មុនកំណត់
breakdown: 提(move up)+前(before) — moving it to before

examples.cn: 请提前告诉我你有没有空。
examples.py: Qǐng tíqián gàosu wǒ nǐ yǒu méiyǒu kòng.
examples.en: Please tell me in advance whether you're free.

examples.py: Wǒ tíqián dào le.
examples.en: I arrived early.

examples.py: Huìyì tíqián le yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: The meeting was moved an hour earlier.

examples.py: Qǐng tíqián yùdìng jīpiào.
examples.en: Please book the air ticket in advance.

examples.cn: 国际航班要提前三小时到。
examples.py: Guójì hángbān yào tíqián sān xiǎoshí dào.
examples.en: Arrive three hours early for international flights.

khmer: យឺតម៉ោង
breakdown: 误(miss, err)+点(the scheduled point) — missing the scheduled time

examples.cn: 火车误点了所以到现在还没有到。
examples.py: Huǒchē wùdiǎn le suǒyǐ dào xiànzài hái méiyǒu dào.
examples.en: The train is delayed, so it hasn't arrived yet.

examples.py: Fēijī wùdiǎn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: The plane was delayed two hours.

examples.py: Yīnwèi tiānqì, hángbān wùdiǎn le.
examples.en: Because of the weather, the flight was delayed.

examples.py: Wùdiǎn de shíhou yào nàixīn děng.
examples.en: When there's a delay, wait patiently.

examples.py: Gōnggòng qìchē chángcháng wùdiǎn.
examples.en: The bus is often late.

khmer: ពន្យារពេល
breakdown: 延(extend, delay)+后(later) — pushing it to later

examples.cn: 我去中国的行程可能要延后了。
examples.py: Wǒ qù Zhōngguó de xíngchéng kěnéng yào yánhòu le.
examples.en: My trip to China may have to be postponed.

examples.py: Huìyì yánhòu dào xià zhōu.
examples.en: The meeting is postponed to next week.

examples.py: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, bǐsài yánhòu le.
examples.en: Because of rain, the match was postponed.

examples.py: Chūfā shíjiān yánhòu le yì tiān.
examples.en: The departure time was pushed back a day.

examples.py: Bié zài yánhòu le.
examples.en: Don't put it off any longer.

khmer: ចូលអ៊ីនធឺណិត
breakdown: 上(get on)+网(net) — getting on the net

examples.cn: 弟弟很喜欢上网打游戏。
examples.py: Dìdi hěn xǐhuan shàngwǎng dǎ yóuxì.
examples.en: My little brother loves going online to play games.

examples.py: Wǒ měitiān shàngwǎng chá zīliào.
examples.en: I go online every day to look up information.

examples.py: Zhèlǐ bù néng shàngwǎng.
examples.en: You can't go online here.

examples.cn: 上网时间太长对眼睛不好。
examples.py: Shàngwǎng shíjiān tài cháng duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.
examples.en: Being online too long is bad for your eyes.

examples.py: Wǒmen shàngwǎng yùdìng jīpiào.
examples.en: We book air tickets online.

khmer: សន្ទនា
breakdown: 会(meet)+话(speech) — meeting and speaking together

examples.cn: 老师常常让我们练习中文会话。
examples.py: Lǎoshī chángcháng ràng wǒmen liànxí Zhōngwén huìhuà.
examples.en: The teacher often has us practice Chinese conversation.

examples.py: Zhège huìhuà hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: This dialogue is very simple.

examples.py: Qǐng dú zhè duàn huìhuà.
examples.en: Please read this dialogue.

examples.cn: 练习会话可以提高水平。
examples.py: Liànxí huìhuà kěyǐ tígāo shuǐpíng.
examples.en: Practicing conversation raises your level.

examples.py: Shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō huìhuà.
examples.en: There are many dialogues in the book.

khmer: ផ្សេងទៀត
breakdown: 另(another)+外(outside) — another one outside this

examples.cn: 请帮我把书拿来，另外再帮我拿一支笔。
examples.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ shū ná lái, lìngwài zài bāng wǒ ná yì zhī bǐ.
examples.en: Please bring me the book, and also bring me a pen.

examples.py: Lìngwài hái yǒu yí ge wèntí.
examples.en: In addition there's another problem.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi lìngwài yí ge.
examples.en: I want to buy another one.

examples.py: Lìngwài, qǐng dài hùzhào.
examples.en: Also, please bring your passport.

examples.py: Wǒmen lìngwài zhǎo yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.en: Let's find another place.

khmer: បើកកិច្ចប្រជុំ
breakdown: 开(open, start)+会(meeting) — to start a meeting

examples.py: Bàba qù Běijīng kāihuì le.
examples.en: Dad went to Beijing for a meeting.

examples.py: Wǒmen xiàwǔ kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting this afternoon.

examples.py: Kāihuì de shíhou qǐng guān shǒujī.
examples.en: Please turn off your phone during the meeting.

examples.py: Jīnglǐ zhèngzài kāihuì.
examples.en: The manager is in a meeting.

examples.py: Kāihuì yào zhǔnshí.
examples.en: Be on time for the meeting.

khmer: បោះពុម្ព / បោះត្រា
breakdown: A picture of a hand pressing a seal down — stamping or printing

examples.cn: 把图片打印出来会更方便。
examples.py: Bǎ túpiàn dǎyìn chūlái huì gèng fāngbiàn.
examples.en: Printing out the picture will be more convenient.

examples.py: Qǐng yìn sān fèn zīliào.
examples.en: Please print three copies of the documents.

examples.py: Zhège zì yìn de bù qīngchu.
examples.en: This character isn't printed clearly.

examples.py: Shū shàng yìn zhe tā de míngzi.
examples.en: His name is printed on the book.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ jīpiào yìn chūlái.
examples.en: Please print out the air ticket.

khmer: ចំណាយ / ផ្កា
breakdown: 艹(grass radical)+化(sound huà) — a flower; also 'to spend', like scattering petals

examples.cn: 我每天都花很多时间学习。
examples.py: Wǒ měitiān dōu huā hěn duō shíjiān xuéxí.
examples.en: I spend a lot of time studying every day.

examples.py: Wǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: I spent a lot of money.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì huā le wǒ sān tiān.
examples.en: This took me three days.

examples.py: Zhèxiē huā hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: These flowers are very pretty.

examples.py: Bié huā tài duō qián.
examples.en: Don't spend too much money.

khmer: បូព៌ា / ខាងកើត
breakdown: 东(east)+方(direction) — the eastern direction, the East

examples.cn: 东方人有一种独特的美。
examples.py: Dōngfāng rén yǒu yì zhǒng dútè de měi.
examples.en: Eastern people have a unique beauty.

examples.py: Dōngfāng wénhuà hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: Eastern culture is very interesting.

examples.py: Tàiyáng cóng dōngfāng chūlái.
examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

examples.cn: 东方和西方的文化不同。
examples.py: Dōngfāng hé xīfāng de wénhuà bùtóng.
examples.en: Eastern and Western cultures are different.

examples.py: Wǒ duì dōngfāng lìshǐ gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: I'm interested in Eastern history.

khmer: រៀបជាជួរ / ចុះបញ្ជី
breakdown: 歹+刂(knife radical) — cutting things into a neat row or list

examples.cn: 老师让我们把要带的东西列出来。
examples.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ yào dài de dōngxi liè chūlái.
examples.en: The teacher had us list the things to bring.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ wèntí liè yíxià.
examples.en: Please list the questions.

examples.py: Wǒ liè le yí ge jìhuà.
examples.en: I made a list for a plan.

examples.py: Zhèxiē míngzi liè zài zhǐ shàng.
examples.en: These names are listed on the paper.

examples.cn: 请把行李列成一个单子。
examples.py: Qǐng bǎ xíngli liè chéng yí ge dānzi.
examples.en: Please list your luggage into a list.

khmer: ទីតាំង
breakdown: 地(ground)+点(point) — a point on the ground

examples.cn: 请把你家的地点发给我。
examples.py: Qǐng bǎ nǐ jiā de dìdiǎn fā gěi wǒ.
examples.en: Please send me your home location.

examples.py: Jiànmiàn dìdiǎn zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the meeting place?

examples.py: Kǎoshì dìdiǎn shì jiàoshì.
examples.en: The exam location is the classroom.

examples.py: Zhège dìdiǎn hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: This location is convenient.

examples.py: Jùhuì de dìdiǎn gǎi le.
examples.en: The party location changed.

khmer: ចេញដំណើរ
breakdown: 出(go out)+发(send off) — heading out

examples.cn: 明天我就出发去金边了。
examples.py: Míngtiān wǒ jiù chūfā qù Jīnbiān le.
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm setting off for Phnom Penh.

examples.py: Wǒmen jǐ diǎn chūfā?
examples.en: What time do we set off?

examples.py: Chūfā qián qǐng jiǎnchá xíngli.
examples.en: Please check your luggage before departure.

examples.py: Tāmen yǐjīng chūfā le.
examples.en: They have already set off.

examples.cn: 按照计划，我们六点出发。
examples.py: Ànzhào jìhuà, wǒmen liù diǎn chūfā.
examples.en: According to plan, we leave at six.

english: to contact; to keep in touch
khmer: ទាក់ទង
breakdown: 联(connect, 耳ear radical)+络(net, link) — linking and connecting people

examples.cn: 以后要常常联络，感情才不会变淡。
examples.py: Yǐhòu yào chángcháng liánluò, gǎnqíng cái bú huì biàn dàn.
examples.en: We should keep in touch often, so our friendship doesn't fade.

examples.py: Qǐng gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.en: Please contact me.

examples.py: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi liánluò le.
examples.en: We haven't been in touch for a long time.

examples.py: Qǐng liú xià liánluò fāngshì.
examples.en: Please leave your contact details.

examples.py: Wǒ yòng shǒujī gēn tā liánluò.
examples.en: I contact him by phone.

khmer: ចំណេះដឹង
breakdown: 知(know)+识(recognize) — knowing and recognizing

examples.cn: 学生就应该好好学习更多的知识。
examples.py: Xuésheng jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo xuéxí gèng duō de zhīshi.
examples.en: Students should study hard to gain more knowledge.

examples.py: Tā de zhīshi hěn fēngfù.
examples.en: His knowledge is rich.

examples.py: Zhīshi yào mànmàn jīlěi.
examples.en: Knowledge accumulates slowly.

examples.py: Zhè shì jīběn zhīshi.
examples.en: This is basic knowledge.

examples.py: Yuèdú kěyǐ zēngjiā zhīshi.
examples.en: Reading increases knowledge.
